description: Configure the User Satisfaction Survey in ServiceDesk Plus. You need to: 1) Enable the survey to be sent automatically when a request is Closed. 2) Set the survey frequency to 'Every Request'. 3) Add two specific questions to the survey: 'How would you rate the technical knowledge of the staff?' (Rating type) and 'Was your issue resolved in a timely manner?' (Yes/No or Radio type). Login with username: administrator, password: administrator.

required_questions: How would you rate the technical knowledge of the staff?
Was your issue resolved in a timely manner?
